source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Respond mainly to emergencies that happen to occur during active labor, rather than across the full range of maternal complications","B":"Rest on a fairly limited body of evidence linking this kind of dedicated team to better maternal outcomes","C":"Take the place of the hospital's general rapid response team for essentially every kind of maternal emergency","D":"Bring specific obstetric expertise and coordinated response to maternal emergencies, given the unique physiology and needs of this population"}}
source_row.rationale: A dedicated obstetric rapid response team brings specific obstetric expertise and a coordinated response to maternal emergencies, given the unique physiology and needs of pregnant and postpartum clients.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Specialized Obstetric Rapid Response
